verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes for saved logins (docs-5), and a user reports relying on it for all 2FA (comm-12). It is available as iOS/Android apps and browser extensions (comm-14), plus a desktop app (docs-9), which implies the same vault is reachable on several devices. However, no evidence explicitly documents automatic cross-device sync of tokens, so the multi-device availability is only inferred. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic real-time sync across devices, tablet support evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of TOTP syncing between phone and computer.
